THE 6-STEP ZERO-DISRUPTION PRACTICE PIPELINE.

01

Automate 100+ CA filings with zero disruption

Connects messy client WhatsApp drops, passwords, scans, and Excel books directly into audit-ready reconciliation pipelines. Zero retraining required for clients or staff, backed by 161 automated deterministic test invariants and complete maker-checker audit trials.

LAUNCH DEMO PACK

Tier-1 Presence & Integrity Check.

Autonomous multi-format inspection across 14 supported tax categories. Detects missing pages, password protections, and corrupted ZIP/Excel sheets before ingestion starts.

Tier-2 Period & Date Alignment.

Strict validation verifying transaction periods match filing fiscal quarters (e.g. FY 2024-25 Q3). Instantly catches trailing month slips or premature filing uploads.

Tier-3 Multi-Way Reconciliation.

100% deterministic cross-matching between GSTR-2B, Sales Books, and Bank Statements down to exact ₹0.01 tolerance with automated discrepancy categorization.

LAUNCH DEMO PACK

BUILT WITH NSVM & ASSOCIATES (6 PARTNERS · 80 STAFF).

Co-designed on the ground with senior audit partners at NSVM & Associates (80+ staff, ₹150Cr+ client GMV audited annually). Built specifically to compress the Day 1 to Day 20 filing crunch from 10 days down to under 48 hours without changing how clients submit documents.
